name: Verizon Communications Inc.
description: Verizon is the largest US wireless carrier by postpaid phone subscribers, organized into two reportable segments: Verizon Consumer Group (wireless service and equipment, Fios fiber and 5G Home/Frontier fiber broadband sold to individual consumers) and Verizon Business Group (wireless, fixed connectivity, networking and IoT/telematics products sold to enterprises, small businesses, government and other carriers on a wholesale basis). Verizon closed its ~$20 billion acquisition of Frontier Communications on 2026-01-20, roughly doubling its fiber footprint and shifting the company's wireline mix decisively toward fiber over legacy copper.

gics.note: Conventional GICS box only; see mowgliClassification for how Mowgli actually places this company.

businessLines.name: Verizon Consumer Group
businessLines.description: Wireless service and equipment plus consumer wireline (Fios and, since 2026-01-20, Frontier fiber) sold directly to individual consumers, including the Verizon Value prepaid portfolio (Visible, Total Wireless, Straight Talk and other TracFone-heritage brands).

businessLines.name: Verizon Business Group
businessLines.description: Wireless, fixed connectivity, networking, security and IoT/telematics products and services sold to enterprise, public-sector, small/medium business and wholesale (other carrier) customers.

brands.name: Verizon (postpaid/premium wireless)
brands.note: Primary consumer and business wireless brand

brands.name: Frontier
brands.note: Fiber/copper broadband network acquired 2026-01-20 for ~$20bn; consolidated into Verizon's results from that date; operated initially as a Verizon-branded fiber expansion into Frontier's ~25-state legacy footprint

brands.name: Verizon Value (prepaid portfolio)
brands.note: Umbrella for TracFone-heritage prepaid brands, organized under Verizon Value since a November 2022 reorganization

brands.name: Verizon Business
brands.note: Enterprise/public-sector/wholesale brand under the Verizon Business Group segment
